author: unknown photographer (halftone)

locator: The whole halftone, 675 x 456 px: the 1874 range at the right, the main block's rear and its veranda at the left.
rights_note: A blog reproduction with no rights statement (the Prairie library's ruling: 'unknown - link only'). Only forms, counts, places and proportions are read from it; nothing is derived from the image as an asset.
access_notes: Read 2026-10-29 (T-3240) from the image store's reference copy, 675 x 456 px greyscale.
note: The rear of the Hibbard house from the yard south-east of it: the 1874 brick range (the blog's 'addition') with round-headed lights, a corbelled oriel on its south face, a heavy bracketed cornice and a high stone basement over the lawn falling toward the lake; the main block's rear with a two-level columned veranda, its balustrades and its steps to the lawn; the main block's railed roof deck and stacks above.
